name: Longshanks Slam

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Requirements You're adjacent to an enemy larger than you.

---
Using a technique pioneered by goblins, you conceal your movements from a larger creature and hit them where it hurts. You use Quick Alchemy to create a bomb or quick vial, then Strike an adjacent creature that's larger than you with it; neither action triggers reactions from the target of your Strike. The creature is Off-Guard to your Strike, but the bomb doesn't deal its splash damage.

---
Special If you have the Quick Bomber feat, you can Step after making the Strike, though you must remain adjacent to the required creature.
